region.definition: Convex hull of all accepted measurement and bound locations; no vent or pseudo-points added.
region.interpretation: Bulk fallout inside the surveyed footprint, including unsampled gaps; not total eruption volume.

model.uncertainty: Predictive mixture; includes disagreement among retained candidates, conditional on each fit and estimated weights. Fitted-parameter uncertainty is not integrated.

selection.assessment: Selection diagnostics; use nested CV for performance estimation.

stacking.screening: Three lowest CV-score candidates per tail family; no screen uses outer holdout responses.

calibration.scope: Additional discrepancy for new observations only; not included in latent maps or volume intervals.
calibration.coverage_guarantee: None. Data-adaptive calibration must be evaluated in outer spatial holdouts.

stacking.assessment: Weight/calibration training diagnostics. Use outer nested validation for performance.

regional_volume.scope: Matched observation hull only; no global integral.
regional_volume.median_surface_note: Integral of pointwise median thickness; not the median of the volume distribution.

joint_volume.interpretation: Conditional joint-surface intervals. Omit fitted-parameter and selection uncertainty. Mean-grid and Monte Carlo checks do not establish tail-quantile quadrature convergence.

selection.assessment: Inner selection diagnostics, not estimates of generalization performance.
selection.search_limitation: Minimum over evaluated discrete grids; no continuous global-optimum guarantee.

regional_volume.scope: Matched observation hull only; no global integral.
regional_volume.median_surface_note: Integral of pointwise median thickness; not the median of the volume distribution.

joint_volume.interpretation: Conditional joint-surface intervals. Omit fitted-parameter and selection uncertainty. Mean-grid and Monte Carlo checks do not establish tail-quantile quadrature convergence.

buffer_rule.rule: Median nearest-distinct-site distance; halve to 1/2, 1/4, then zero only if an inner training set lacks six exact values/four distinct non-collinear sites.
buffer_rule.uses: Coordinates and observation kinds only; never thickness values.

validation.scope: All response-dependent fitting and selection repeated in outer training sets. Full survey coordinates supply the common rectangle/hull.
validation.primary_metric: equal_region_log_score; lower is better; no automatic preferred method

notes: All probability intervals condition on fitted parameters and selected settings; they omit parameter/selection and preservation/sampling uncertainty.
Four geographic outer folds evaluate the entire tuning procedure; this is development evidence, not independent external validation.
Geographic-deletion volume ranges show refitting sensitivity and are not confidence intervals.
GP ensemble: held-out 95% observation coverage is only 83.9%; uncertainty is undercovered.
Trend-regularized cubic spline: held-out 95% observation coverage is only 79.3%; uncertainty is undercovered.
